title: Runtime gate must block skipped checks

root_causes: Skipped checks were not delivery evidence
recommended_actions: Treat SKIPPED and NOT_RUN as blocking

resolution: Fail closed and emit repair tasks

title: Deployment rollback evidence is required

observation.symptom: A deployment had no previous build backup

resolution: Block delivery when rollback is unavailable

title: Knowledge context must be bounded

observation.symptom: Role context omitted relevant knowledge cases

root_causes: Context packager had no knowledge loader
recommended_actions: Load bounded knowledge cases for each role

resolution: Include up to three knowledge cases within the context budget
